events.source_span: The warlord looks at the thin red line of Roman shields and orders the full charge across the open field.
events.note: Units advance and make frontline contact

events.source_span: Before the lines collide, a deadly volley of heavy javelins arches through the sky, crushing enemy ranks.
events.note: Missile volley launched across engagement line

events.source_span: The two armies collide with a deafening crash as Roman scutum shields lock together like an unyielding wall.

events.source_span: They thought they had broken the line, but the tired hastati calmly rotate back through the gaps.
